title: OpenStage slide file
description: One slide per file, in slides/. See docs/format-spec.md.

duration.description: null waits for the learner; a number is milliseconds before auto-advance.

layout.description: The id of the layout the slide was made from, or null. Layouts are built into the editor.

background.description: A theme background such as theme:bg.dark, a hex colour, or null for the theme's default.

hideNavigation.description: Optional, added in 0.34.0. true means the course's own Back and Next are not shown on this slide, so the learner leaves it only through a button or link on the slide itself. Absent means they are shown. Used by the games, where the way on is the game.

provenance.description: Optional. Set on a slide that the Capture module made from a recorded step, or that was imported from a slide of a PowerPoint deck, so a changed recording or deck can be brought forward without losing the author's edits.
